shows: Cladogram of 12 taxa in NCBI Taxonomy's nesting, with the six flying or gliding lineages marked and their genome-assembly counts and oldest PBDB fossil occurrence beside them. Three PBDB first appearances are shown corrected by us, with PBDB's value struck through: Diptera 390.5 to 247 Ma (a Devonian probable genus-name homonym), Crocodylia 237 to 201.4 Ma (a probable misassigned reef-collection record and trace fossils), Sciurini 41.03 to 37 Ma (an ischyromyid filed under Sciurus); Cynocephalidae is flagged as doubtful
provenance: NCBI Datasets v2 taxonomy/taxon (topology and taxids) and genome/taxon dataset_report (assembly counts); Paleobiology Database data1.2 taxa/single show=app (first appearance) and occs/list, occs/single, taxa/list and refs/single for the occurrence-level checks behind the corrections. All calls logged in dashboard/figures/DATA.md and cached under dashboard/figures/cache/
kind: cladogram: topology drawn from NCBI Taxonomy for orientation, annotations measured
